# Topcoder

> > Topcoder is a crowdsourcing platform connecting a global community of competitive programmers, designers, and data scientists to solve real-world problems through contests and collaborative projects.

Topcoder hosts algorithmic competitions, design challenges, and crowdsourced development projects with a community of over 1 million members. The platform features Single Round Matches (SRM), Topcoder Open (TCO) championships, and partnerships with enterprises for machine learning and data science solutions.

## Key Topics

- Competitive Programming
- Crowdsourcing
- Algorithm Contests
- Machine Learning
- TCO (Topcoder Open)
- SRM (Single Round Match)
- C++ & Java
- Remote Work
- Community
- Data Science
- Quantum Computing
- Game Development
- Career Development
- Freelance Opportunities

## Tutorials & Technical Guides

- [Basic Python: Lists, Tuples, Sets, Dictionaries](https://topcoder.com/blog/basic-python-lists-tuples-sets-dictionaries): Beginner guide to Python data structures: lists, tuples, sets, and dictionaries.
- [Calling APIs and Parsing JSON with Swift](https://topcoder.com/blog/calling-apis-parsing-json-with-swift): Swift tutorial on API integration and JSON parsing using SwiftyJSON library.
- [Duetsch-Jozsa's Algorithm in Quantum Computing](https://topcoder.com/blog/duetsch-jozsas-algorithm-in-quantum-computing): Tutorial on Deutsch-Jozsa's Algorithm and quantum computing concepts and gates.
- [2019 Insomnia Editorials](https://topcoder.com/blog/2019-insomnia-editorials): Solution editorials for 2019 Insomnia contest with dynamic programming and algorithms.

## Resources & Ebooks

- [Enterprise Data Science & Analytics Ebook](https://topcoder.com/blog/enterprise-data-science-analytics-ebook): Ebook on enterprise data science, machine learning, and crowdsourced analytics.
- [Your Business's Design and Development Cheat Sheet Has Arrived](https://topcoder.com/blog/design-and-development-smb-ebook): SMB ebook on design and development strategy for small business growth.
